development.purpose: primitive discovery and source repair only

managed_policy_calibration.purpose: gross managed-policy value calibration without execution-cost claims

rolling_validation.purpose: walk-forward component falsification; previously revealed slices are descriptive only

sealed_holdout.purpose: single final structural reveal after all v2.1 fingerprints are frozen

revealed_development_diagnostic.purpose: source and component diagnostics only; excluded from v2.1 fitting and parameter selection

leakage_rules: The three playbook semantics and ordered path protocols remain unchanged.
June-July 2024 MBO outcomes cannot fit or select v2.1 parameters.
Belief probability cannot be represented as managed-policy expected return.
Managed-policy calibration uses only 2023 gross structural episodes and subtracts observed MBO cost only at runtime.
A decision snapshot and all code, config, belief and policy-value hashes must be sealed before future reveal.
AI review may propose only registered sequence primitives and has no action, outcome or profit-label authority.
Any post-reveal model change creates a new protocol and requires later untouched data.
